#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduction script generated by kimi_k3_estimates.py.
# Run with: bash commands.txt
set -euo pipefail
export MPLCONFIGDIR=/Users/mimehta/.codex/worktrees/cd94/kimi-k3/aiconfigurator_estimates/results/kimi-k3-20260913T225810268008Z/matplotlib
AICONFIGURATOR=/Users/mimehta/aiconfigurator/.venv/bin/aiconfigurator
COMMON=(--model-path moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --system h200_sxm --isl 1000 --osl 1000 --ctx-tokens 1000 --database-mode SILICON)
# --attention-dp-size N: replicate the attention computation across N data-parallel groups.
# --moe-tp-size N: split each MoE expert tensor computation across N GPUs.
# --moe-ep-size N: distribute the MoE expert set across N GPUs (expert parallelism).
# For TP8xDP2, AIC requires attention DP=2 and MoE TP=16/EP=1:
# this is AIC's global-width approximation to two measured TP8 replicas without EP.

run_estimate() {
  local label=$1 batch=$2 mode=$3; shift 3
  echo "# ${label}"
  "$AICONFIGURATOR" cli estimate "${COMMON[@]}" --batch-size "$batch" --estimate-mode "$mode" "$@" --detail source
}

# report comparisons
for c in 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 256 512; do
  batch=$(((c + 1 - 1) / 1))
  run_estimate "report/TP16-c${c}" "$batch" agg --backend vllm --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 16 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 1 --moe-tp-size 16 --moe-ep-size 1
done
for c in 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 256 512; do
  batch=$(((c + 1 - 1) / 1))
  run_estimate "report/TEP16-c${c}" "$batch" agg --backend vllm --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 16 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 1 --moe-tp-size 1 --moe-ep-size 16
done
for c in 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 256 512; do
  batch=$(((c + 2 - 1) / 2))
  run_estimate "report/TP8xPP2-c${c}" "$batch" agg --backend vllm --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 8 --pp-size 2 --attention-dp-size 1 --moe-tp-size 8 --moe-ep-size 1
done
for c in 1 2 4 8 16; do
  batch=$(((c + 2 - 1) / 2))
  run_estimate "report/TP8xDP2-c${c}" "$batch" agg --backend vllm --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 8 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 2 --moe-tp-size 16 --moe-ep-size 1
done
